## Charter

- [ ] **Do no harm.** Safe for ages 7–13, collects nothing, only touches `apps/<my-game-id>/`, and `npm test` passes.
- [ ] **Teaches one named skill**, listed in the manifest.
- [ ] **The child stays in charge.** Asking the practice AI is optional and has a cost; checking is rewarded.
- [ ] **It's fun.** A child would play it twice.
- [ ] It ships `parents/<lang>.html` for every language it offers.
- [ ] I tried it on a phone (or a 360 px wide browser window), in portrait and landscape.
- [ ] This is my only open pull request on kidvo.
- [ ] I have the right to share everything in it, and I agree to MIT (code) and CC BY 4.0 (texts, art, sound).
